Subject: Fellowship cohort — cloud credits request and short timeline

Hi Marissa,

I'm Laila, program director for the BrightFutures Early-Career Fellowship. We're launching a small cohort of 12 fellows who will be building research assistants for low-resource language documentation over a 12-week period. A number of the projects rely on fine-tuning and evaluation workloads that will run across weeks, not just short spikes.

We applied for the promotional academic pool last year and used a small amount, but this cohort is bigger and time-sensitive: we need predictable credits for experimentation, model-hosting for evaluation, and the ability to run nightly tokenized evaluation jobs. Could Redwood provide a 6-month trial extension or a block of promotional credits (roughly 200k token-equivalents) to cover compute for the cohort? We can provide the fellowship proposal and a short budget outline (attached).

Two constraints: we need the credits committed by June 1 to include onboarding in week 1, and we require a SOC2-compliant data handling note for participant data (some PAIRs include small speech samples). Happy to sign an MSA addendum if that helps.

Best,
Laila
Dr. Laila Anwar
Program Director, BrightFutures Fellowship

Marissa / Laila — quick calc here after reviewing the budget spreadsheet. If the cohort uses a mix of lightweight fine-tuning (mostly LoRA-style) and nightly evals, 200k token-equivalents should be safe for an initial 3-month tranche. For a 6-month runway, we recommend 450k–600k token-equivalents to avoid mid-program interruptions.

Pricing option for non-profit/edu promo: we can offer a 50% promo discount on hosted token rates for the first 250k tokens and provide a $500 account credit for onboarding support (engineering hours). For longer commitments (MSA with addendum) we can provide a staged credit release: 40% up-front, 30% at month 2, 30% at month 4.

Priyom — can you confirm whether finance needs an internal PO or a signed DocuSign to lock the promotional tranche? Also flagging that usage monitoring needs to be on from day 1 to avoid accidental overages; we'll set a hard budget alert.

Thanks all — Security and Compliance are okay with the request as long as three conditions are met:
1) No persistent storage of raw speech on hosted endpoints; any speech artifacts must be stored encrypted in customer-managed buckets (we can provide guidance on S3 + KMS).
2) Fellows must sign a short participant data agreement; BrightFutures can be the data controller and list Redwood as subprocesser. We can draft a one-paragraph addendum.
3) For the promo credits we need a one-page statement of research purpose for the cohort and an institutional sig (letterhead).

If those are provided, Compliance approves a 6-month promotional allocation of up to 300k token-equivalents under the education/nonprofit promo. We'll need to record the allocation in our internal grant ledger (I will cc Legal if anything unusual pops up).

Naomi Feldman
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
